title: Customer Sale Returns & Statutory GST Credit Notes (Alt + R)

intro.title: Customer Sale Returns & Credit Notes
intro.subtitle: Partial strip and tablet returns, automatic expiry quarantine, sequential CN numbers, and GSTR-1 reporting

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 16: Customer Sale Returns and Statutory GST Credit Notes. When patients return unconsumed medicines or alter prescriptions, MediFlow issues verified credit notes with strict compliance.
Open the completed invoice and click Return Items, or press Alt plus R from the invoice screen to open the Return workflow.
MediFlow supports partial returns across both full strips and fractional loose tablets, with strict quantity caps ensuring you never return more than originally billed.
Returned medicines are restored to their exact original batch. If the batch expired after the bill date, MediFlow automatically places the stock into statutory quarantine hold.
Submit the return to generate a permanent sequential Credit Note voucher, adjust customer khata, and report to GSTR-1. In Part 17, we master Cash Register Shifts and Drawer Audits!

outro.takeaway: Customer Sale Returns: Issue sequential GST credit notes, restore batches with automatic expiry quarantine, and enforce exact quantity return caps.
